UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile with Google account avatar, display name, verified email domain, and role-based access control metadata.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified official domain email address fetched from Google account.

displayName.description: Full display name fetched from Google account.

photoURL.description: Avatar image URL fetched from Google account.

role.description: Assigned RBAC role for protected routes and actions.

platform.description: Client runtime platform used during authentication.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Immutable security audit log entry recording authentication and domain verification events.

uid.description: UID of the user who triggered the audit event.

email.description: Email address evaluated by the domain gate.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the audit event.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted admin lookup record for RBAC verification.

grantedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin privilege was granted.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores verified @hbplus.fit user profiles with Google avatar, displayName, email, and RBAC.

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Stores immutable authentication and domain verification audit logs.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Trusted administrator registry for Zero-Trust RBAC lookups.
